title: PublishResult
description: Outcome of draft GitHub PR (Route A) or issue fix-snippet delivery (Route B)

delivery.description: Route A draft_pr vs Route B issue_snippet

draft.description: True for draft PRs; false for issue_snippet delivery

result_id.description: Sandbox validated_fix_record.result_id this delivery is gated on

branch.description: Agent branch name raphael/<run-id>-<summary> (empty for issue_snippet)

pull_request_url.description: Real PR URL in live mode; documented dry-run placeholder URL when dry_run

dry_run.description: True when no GitHub mutation occurred

idempotent_replay.description: True when an existing PR URL was reused

html_compare_url.description: Optional compare URL used as dry-run placeholder

fix_snippet.description: Unified or file-contents snippet posted for human PR
